sentences.text: The application stands disposed of accordingly.

These appeals under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgments i.e.
impugned judgment dated 10.05.2023 passed in LAC No. 150/2018 in respect of the Award No.
12/2005-06 pertaining to revenue estate of Village Barwala and impugned judgment dated 14.08.2023 passed in LAC No. 60/2020 in respect of the Award No. 12/2005-06.
2. Issue notice.
3. Notice is accepted by Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, learned Standing Counsel appearing for the Union of India and Ms. Shobha Takiar, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of Delhi Development Authority (DDA).
4.

Learned Standing Counsel for UOI submits that the Land Acquisition Collector has determined the market value of land acquired vide the said Award @ 15,70,000/- per acre for block "A" and Rs 14,00,000/- per acre for land falling in B" block and Rs.12,30,000/- per acre for land falling in block "C".

He further submits that in the present appeal, the appellant seeks further enhancement of compensation of Rs.50,000/- per bigha over and above the amount passed in the reference award,
besides other statutory benefits including interest on solatium.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/10/2023 at 00:33:13 5.

Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak learned counsel further informs that the issue raised in these appeals is similar to the one raised in L.A. APP No. 138/2018 titled Chander Bhan (deceased) through LRs v Union of India & Ors, which was listed before this Court on 13.08.2018 and was admitted on the same day and is now listed in the category of Regular Matters.
6. Admit.
7. List both these appeals in due course in the category of 'Regular Matters' alongwith L.A. APP No.
138/2018 titled as "Chander Bhan (deceased) through LRs vs. Union of India and Ors."
ANISH DAYAL, J OCTOBER 19, 2023/SM
